satellites.title: A Fork in the Road
satellites.evidence: 歧路 names a forked road. In the Seeking realm it is a concrete lexical example of the problem of choosing among paths, not a historical religious doctrine.

satellites.title: Too Many Forks, the Sheep Is Lost
satellites.evidence: Liezi, Shuofu: a neighbour’s sheep is lost because the road forks and forks again, and the moral drawn is 大道以多歧亡羊，學者以多方喪生 — the great road loses its sheep through many forks, the learner loses their life through many methods.
satellites.caveat: The Liezi’s date is disputed; many place its received text around 300 CE.
